book_b_decision_rule.text: Book B hard_skip IFF (1) keyword ThemeShock candidate (golden-set row = Book A keyword path) AND (2) gpu_critic nest present (never fabricated) AND (3) critic does NOT suppress. Suppress if ANY: action in shadow_would_suppress/would_suppress*; contamination_risk>=0.6; matched_field=summary with top_theme not in AI_ALIGN; OR top_theme not in AI_ALIGN (proxy for Stage A theme_prob[theme]≥τ confirm — τ unset in brief). AI_ALIGN={ai_compute, ai_mega_cap, memory_hbm}. Missing critic → no_attach (counts against recall; excluded from Book B hard_skip numerators).
book_b_decision_rule.book_a: keyword ThemeShock baseline via expected_action on labels
book_b_decision_rule.note: Live critic actions on seed are all shadow_pass (0× would_suppress); gate therefore hinges on top_theme AI_ALIGN + contam/summary filters per Stage A brief §1.
